crossrefs.text: Be careful that you do not forget the covenant of the LORD your God that He made with you; do not make an idol for yourselves in the form of anything He has forbidden you.
Now if you will indeed obey My voice and keep My covenant, you will be My treasured possession out of all the nations—for the whole earth is Mine.
And all the people answered together, “We will do everything that the LORD has spoken.” So Moses brought their words back to the LORD.
Mount Sinai was completely enveloped in smoke, because the LORD had descended on it in fire. And the smoke rose like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked violently.
And as the sound of the ramʼs horn grew louder and louder, Moses spoke and God answered him in the thunder.
Hear now, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances I am teaching you to follow, so that you may live and may enter and take possession of the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, is giving you.

The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will come to you in a dense cloud, so that the people will hear when I speak with you, and they will always put their trust in you.” And Moses relayed to the LORD what the people had said.
So Moses took the blood, splattered it on the people, and said, “This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.”
Honor your father and mother, so that your days may be long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
“I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
You shall not covet your neighborʼs house. You shall not covet your neighborʼs wife, or his manservant or maidservant, or his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.”
You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.
You shall not murder.

but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments.
You shall not covet your neighborʼs house. You shall not covet your neighborʼs wife, or his manservant or maidservant, or his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.”
but this is what I commanded them: Obey Me, and I will be your God, and you will be My people. You must walk in all the ways I have commanded you, so that it may go well with you.
If only you had paid attention to My commandments, your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness like waves of the sea.

Keep His statutes and commandments, which I am giving you today, so that you and your children after you may prosper, and that you may live long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you for all time.
You shall therefore love the LORD your God and always keep His charge, His statutes, His ordinances, and His commandments.
So My people come to you as usual, sit before you, and hear your words; but they do not put them into practice. Although they express love with their mouths, their hearts pursue dishonest gain.
Indeed, you are to them like a singer of love songs with a beautiful voice, who skillfully plays an instrument. They hear your words but do not put them into practice.

O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were unwilling!
Be very strong, then, so that you can keep and obey all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, not turning aside from it to the right or to the left.
